title: Put AI to work: learn about the person before suggesting a step
origin: Spec #75 (starters and the open door), "Getting to know them" (AI)
testerLines: Priya. put AI to work for me

testerLines.say: I'm a project manager at a construction company, drowning in meeting notes and status emails
testerLines.means: project manager at a construction company, buried in meeting notes and status emails
testerLines.when: after ZOH asks about her work or what she'd like AI to help with

testerLines.say: honestly I've barely used ChatGPT, maybe twice
testerLines.means: has barely used ChatGPT, maybe twice
testerLines.when: after ZOH asks what she's tried with AI or how much she's used it

testerLines.say: weekday mornings around 9:30 after standup, like 15 min
testerLines.means: weekday mornings around 9:30 after standup, about 15 minutes
testerLines.when: after ZOH asks when or how long she'd spend on it

facts: you're a project manager at a construction company
meeting notes and status emails take hours of your week
you've used ChatGPT maybe twice, for nothing serious
you work on a laptop at the office
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the AI starter.
shouldHaveHappened: After Priya picks the AI starter, ZOH asks about her (her work, the tasks she'd like to hand off, what she's tried with AI) one question per text before suggesting any first step, each question following from what she just said. It never asks something her answers already covered (her job, that she's barely used it, her time and minutes) and never grills her like a form. It doesn't push a paid app or product she didn't ask about, invents no features or links, and once what, when and how long are covered it moves toward a plan without re-asking them.
